name: How long does kitchen tile installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen tile installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most kitchen tile installation projects take between two and four days from start to finish. The timeline breaks down into specific phases: surface preparation and demolition on day one, setting the tiles with thin-set mortar on day two, and applying grout after the mortar cures on day three. If your project includes extensive leveling, complex layout patterns, or large square footage, it may take additional time. Homeowners should plan for grout and sealants to cure fully before moving heavy kitchen appliances back into place or resuming full foot traffic.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard kitchen tile installation takes two to four days, allowing adequate time for subfloor preparation, mortar curing, and grouting.
